==='''SFX Magazine Interview 1997'''===


'''''posted on rec.arts.sf.written.robert-jordan by I Blandford'''''



Right then, this is my first mailing so God have mercy on my soul if I write something offensive, stupid, boring or grammatically incorrect...<br />

Anyway, a British SF magazine (SFX) had an interview with RJ a few months back, circa Feb or Mar I think. In the interview he said a few things which I haven't read in the FAQ or the newsgroup:<br />

Firstly, in the event of his death his will states that his notes on TWoT are to be destroyed and no-one is to complete the series for him.<br />

Secondly, The Final Battle (Tarmon Gai-don or however it's spelled) has already started but only now (book 7) are the characters beginning to realise this.<br />

Thirdly, in defeating the DO, the good guys can expect absolutely no help off the creator, and no miracles will occur.<br />

So when did the Final Battle begin then, book 1 chp1 or later, or earlier?<br />



URL for report: http://groups.google.com/group/rec.arts.sf.written.robert-jordan/browse_thread/thread/17b0ebb9d662d36/c26c7aa2d58ef50b



Note: The only surviving online bit of this interview seems to be that posted above. There seems to be a discrepancy in the date of publication, because while the information posted above suggests the interview was from early 1997, reference 3 of the Wikipedia entry for [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Wheel_of_Time The Wheel of Time] indicates that it was from SFX Magazine #16, September 1996.
